text:
The Royal Oak Jumbo, in a metal that behaves like glass.

On this version of Audemars Piguet's Royal Oak "Jumbo" Extra-Thin, the polished bezel and centre bracelet links are bulk metallic glass (BMG). It is a palladium-based alloy cooled so quickly that it sets without a crystal structure, just like glass. The rest of the case and bracelet is brushed titanium.

The dial is smoked burgundy: bright red at the centre, fading to near-black at the edge, with pink gold markers.

AP first used this titanium and BMG combination on a one-off Royal Oak for Only Watch 2021, then released this model in 2023. 39 mm wide, 8.1 mm thick, automatic. Price on request.
